svg.title: Four detectors and one place for findings
svg.desc: On the left, four kinds of evidence in an AWS account: activity logs, workloads, S3 buckets and resource configurations. Each feeds one service: Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, Amazon Macie and AWS Config. Arrows carry their findings to AWS Security Hub. From Security Hub, findings go to Amazon EventBridge, and Amazon Detective investigates one finding.
